verdict.rationale: Braintrust clearly offers prompt management: the API can manage prompts, the MCP server can author prompts, the `bt` CLI manages functions, and Playgrounds give a no-code workspace for iterating on prompts. The other two halves of the story are not evidenced: nothing documents prompt versioning (only datasets are described as versioned), and nothing shows prompt changes reaching production without a code deploy. missing for 10: explicit prompt version history, deploying or promoting prompt versions to production (environments, runtime prompt loading) without a code change, independent or hands-on corroboration.
